key_prior_art.paper: Emmerson, Walsh and Southwell 2019 Ecology and Evolution
key_prior_art.observational_link: RFID automated weighbridge mass/crossing events + handheld tagged bird nest resight + daily direct nest egg/chick census for subset
key_prior_art.source_adult_status: breeder observed at a nest during incubation or eggs in daily census; nonbreeder = bird tagged and detected visiting colony but no verified breeding attempt; no data on birds never visited
key_prior_art.source_tag_detection_condition: reader >98% when individual was tightly sitting on nest; NOT sensitivity of a breeding population census, and not 98% for arrivals, missed breeders or nonbreeder status
key_prior_art.crossing_number_abundance: up to 150 tagged breeders and up to 50 tagged nonbreeders during one five-day interval, NOT independent total cohort size
key_prior_art.past_study_primary_outcome: within-season mass trajectories breeders vs nonbreeders, 2019 published
key_prior_art.past_study_also_knew_failed_breeders_wit: yes in subset observed via direct daily nest censuses
key_prior_art.does_not_establish_next_year_first_egg_o: not shown in main analyzed comparisons; original longitudinal tag records required
key_prior_art.nonbreeders_include: prospective young never breeders AND prior breeding birds skipping years; very early egg failures can be mistaken nonbreeders

new_candidate_question_conditional_on_or: Among known-age RFID-tagged adults detected visiting the colony before laying, and verified by adequate nest effort as nonbreeders in t, do they initiate their first egg in t+1 and does condition/social access alter transition relative to age/individual quality and environmental variation?

source_download_truth.official_mechanism: Publisher's EDS download system presents browser/interstitial requiring requester email for ZIP or S3 access keys; entering user email, receipt of credentials and human data-custodian contact have NOT occurred.
source_download_truth.most_recent_actual_source_response: HTML Javascript application shell 206 for 5516 and guide 5228; do not treat as a corrupted binary or read bird IDs
source_download_truth.data_custodian_in_publisher: Louise Emmerson; 2019 correspondence email published Louise.Emmerson@aad.gov.au; request technical note and data use guidance prior to deep analysis
source_download_truth.publisher_data_policy: Publisher expects contact with data originator before applying dataset; original weighbridge records are unprocessed and require specialist processing

strict_inference_states: source_field_observation: RFID first entrance at a gate within a season is FIRST DETECTED CROSSING, not proven first ever colony ARRIVAL
tagged/non-tagged sampling frame is selective; tag coverage unknown and a gate spans certain subcolonies
source_positive_BREEDER: same tag ID at a nest with directly verified egg; tag detected on nest alone may reflect incubation but if direct egg not documented label NEST_PRESENT not EGG_CONFIRMED
source_negative_NEST_NOT_SEEN: implies UNKNOWN EGG not CONFIRMED NONE, even though >98% of tightly sitting nest adults detected
source_previously_never_bred: require known-age cohort and adequate previous-at-risk years, not first observed at gate
do not treat repeated crossings of same tag as independent new arrivals
if egg was before first gate event that season, disallow direction gate->egg
if resight tag encoding compatibility unverified, disallow person-level join
absence of prior nest detection ≠ absence of prior egg; year-specific observation effort required
photo/census egg confirmation and survival are different outcomes
2019 observed breeder-vs-nonbreeder mass curves and original tag-state join already prior art; any new paper must ask new actual event transition beyond it
minimum_next_gate: official two original raw file manifests including individual tag-ID encoding and year-specific gate uptime and nest search effort
documented 2006–2018 same-individual-ID collision/reuse QA and breeding attempt/fate fields
unique at-risk tag cohort in multiple seasons with explicit previous first-breeding history
add external unexposed colony/island observations and dated independent habitat access for causal island biogeography
